title: Malee COCO Coconut Matcha: trend launch via a 7-Eleven exclusive
what_happened: Malee launched a 350 ml coconut water + Uji matcha drink at THB 35, 7-Eleven only for Jan-Mar 2026, then all channels from April. Target: lift coconut water share from 30% (2025) to 35% (2026).
what_worked: Malee reports higher Malee COCO sales volume in 9M 2026, attributed to the matcha launch. The 7-Eleven test window gave fast national reach before the wider rollout.
what_didnt: Competitors followed: Coco Royal launched a coconut + Uji matcha drink at Lotus's, Lawson and Jiffy (Oct 2026), and Ichitan said it is developing a coconut water + matcha drink. Own-brand revenue still fell 19.8% YoY in 9M 2026 (mainly dairy and juice).
why: The trend product sat on Malee's strongest asset (COCO, about 30% share). That made it easy to copy, and one SKU cannot offset declines in the bigger lines.
suggestion_for_malee: Track Coco Royal and Ichitan matcha SKUs in this dashboard. Defend with format/size variants and a COCO-family price ladder rather than discounts. Report whether 35% COCO share was reached [needs Nielsen data].
confidence: Sourced; the causal link between launch and volume is Malee's own claim
test_next_month: Test Malee could run next month: list Malee COCO Coconut Matcha 350 ml in a 2-pack at Lotus's in 20 stores vs 20 control stores (no discount, bundle only) and compare 4-week unit sales against the stores where Coco Royal matcha is on shelf.

title: Tipco 100% NFC orange relaunch (50th year)
what_happened: Tipco relaunched 100% NFC orange (Sai Nam Phueng, Tangerine) 200 ml with a clean 'Less is More' pack built on consumer insight. 7-Eleven first at the same price, other channels later. The CEO said orange is about 50% of juice and more launches were planned for Sep-Oct 2026.
what_worked: Clear, simple proof point (NFC, no sugar added, no preservatives), varietal colour coding on shelf, and no price increase. Convenience stores first, matching where single-serve is bought.
what_didnt: No public sales result yet. Tipco beverage revenue was down 11% in 6M 2026 and juice was cited as weak; the relaunch effect is [Unverified].
why: Tipco is attacking the biggest flavour (orange) on 'naturalness' (NFC) rather than price, aiming at Malee's premium positioning.
suggestion_for_malee: Add Tipco NFC orange 200 ml vs the matching Malee orange 200 ml to the price tracker. Check that Malee's 100% orange 1 L is listed at Lotus's/Big C (not found online on 17 Nov 2026). Prepare a counter-message on Malee's functional claims (e.g. hesperidin).
test_next_month: Test Malee could run next month: run a shelf-talker 'hesperidin / 100% juice' message on Malee 100% orange at 7-Eleven in one region vs a control region, at unchanged price, to see if a functional claim defends share against Tipco's NFC message.

title: Tipco moves from promo dependence to promo discipline
what_happened: In Q1 2026 Tipco said price competition forced it to keep running promotions to hold customers, with traditional trade weak. In Q2 2026 it cut low-return promotions and marketing spend: sales -13% YoY, but continuing-operations profit +22% and gross margin held at 36% in beverages.
what_worked: Profit and margin improved while volume fell. Tipco now runs targeted retailer promos (e.g. -10% on 1 L apple and orange at Big C until 3 Dec 2026) instead of broad discounts.
what_didnt: Revenue kept falling (9M 2026 sales THB 1,351m vs 1,508m). Traditional trade and export were weak.
why: Fewer, better-targeted promotions protect margin but give up share in price-sensitive channels.
suggestion_for_malee: Use the Promotions tab to time counter-promos around Tipco's retailer windows (e.g. Big C until 3 Dec 2026) rather than matching every discount. Watch traditional trade, where Tipco is retreating, as a possible share opportunity [Unverified].
confidence: Sourced (Tipco SET filings); interpretation is the analyst's
test_next_month: Test Malee could run next month: when Tipco runs a Big C discount (e.g. apple -10% to 3 Dec 2026), match it in half of the Big C stores only and hold price in the other half; compare Malee unit sales and margin per store for 2 weeks.
